about: Cohance Lifesciences is a Hyderabad-based CDMO operating across pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, APIs, formulations and specialty chemicals. The company states that it features among the Top 20 CDMOs globally; its Pharma CDMO business works with 19 of the top 20 global innovators, while the API portfolio ranks among the top three suppliers in 8 of its top 10 molecules.
